## Research notes on foundation models and intelligent systems

I study modern AI systems by tracing their history, deriving the mathematics, implementing the core algorithms, and testing them with controlled ablations.

The first series contains three long-form technical essays. Each essay is maintained as a living document rather than split into shallow daily posts.

## Blogs

## Writing standard

Every substantial article should contain four things: derivation, executable code, controlled ablation, and an honest failure analysis. Claims about closed models are labeled as **official**, **third-party estimate**, or **unknown**.
